items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Like she said, one of the saddest things, like was when Papa Jo Jones was like a mentor you see and everything. I mean he raised me professionally and everything.

ctx.x: Like she said, one of the saddest things, like was when Papa Jo Jones was like a mentor you see and everything. I mean he raised me professionally and everything. And wherever we went after we left New York, and I was called to Bennington to teach and then Wisconsin and finally L.A. But the thing is is that he would show up at my first concert, wherever I held it. And nobody’d tell him.
He’d just be sitting there backstage there in the chair with his handkerchief.
